answers.ask: You asked for a very detailed map but did not say what it is - a city, a forest, an island, something else?
answers.answer: Make it a detailed modern city map, with streets, buildings, parks, and interior-style decorative detail but no labels placed around the map or on the ground.

answers.ask: How big should the walkable area be - a plaza, a neighbourhood, or a whole world?
answers.answer: Use a neighbourhood-sized walkable area so it feels detailed and explorable while staying focused for the clicker game.

scene_prompt: Create a detailed modern city neighbourhood map with a focused, fully walkable area. Arrange streets between varied buildings, with parks and interior-style decorative detail throughout; do not place labels, signs with text, or ground markings that function as labels anywhere in the map.
agent_notes: Simulation, because a clicker with rebirth multipliers is the incremental family the index files under this genre — the parkour-free city is scenery for the click loop, not a second genre. world-open is the genre default and the right read of the answer's neighbourhood-sized modern city: one shared walkable map with no personal plot, streets, buildings and parks explorable in any order. Incremental Simulator keeps its shape; path-circulation is the street grain that makes the city walkable and settlement-density is the built-up block density the answer asked for, while social-hub and gate-progression were dropped because the prompt has no shop and no gated zones. Decided without a user: 'interior-style decorative detail' was read as dressing rather than enterable buildings, so the build stays on P0; the rebirth button and the admin panel are screen UI the prompt puts on screen rather than pads to place; and 'no labels around the map or on the ground' is carried as a build constraint that no text geometry is generated.

notes: cleared axes on a shape build: enclosure=, verticality=, zone-count=, structure=, play-space=
